name: ultimate-tokens
description: Ultimate Tokens — a perceptually-even color-palette + semantic-token generator built on the HCT color space (pure engine, web component, Figma plugin).

scripts.build: npm run gen:figma-assets && npm run gen:mcp-assets && npm run gen:categories && npm run gen:adia-exports && tsc && vite build && npm run bundle && npm run gen:figma-ui
scripts.test: npm run gen:figma-assets && npm run gen:mcp-assets && npm run gen:categories && npm run gen:adia-exports && npm run bundle && npm run gen:figma-ui && node test/run.mjs
scripts.gate:sweeps: npm run gate:corpus-tonal && npm run gate:corpus-anchor && npm run gate:sweep-prime && npm run gate:corpus-reset && npm run gate:corpus-contrast && npm run gate:mode-isolation
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node test/smoke/launcher.mjs && node test/smoke/smoke.mjs
